_comment: RAMP step 3-5. 10 concepts across the 5 angles. No numbers anywhere: facts.json is empty, so nothing is substantiated yet. Vocabulary is theirs (firm/soft/flat/height) - never 'loft', which appears twice in 636 items.

concepts.angle: A2 failed-solution: wrong height, not bad brand
hooks: You didn't buy bad pillows. You bought the wrong height.
Three pillows in. Still waking up sore.
The pillow wasn't the problem. The height was.

slots.eyebrow: If you've bought more than one
slots.hook:
You didn't buy bad pillows.
You bought the wrong height.
slots.left_copy: Soft or firm. Then hope. Then another one in six months.
slots.right_copy: How far your shoulder holds your head off the mattress.

concepts.angle: A2 failed-solution: wrong height, not bad brand
hooks: Too low squishes your shoulder. Too high bends your neck.
There is a right height. It's yours, not ours.
Both ways of getting it wrong feel like a bad pillow.

slots.hook:
Too low squishes your shoulder.
Too high bends your neck.
slots.headline: There is a height between those.
slots.subhead: It's set by your shoulder, not by how the pillow feels in the shop.

concepts.angle: A1 pain-led: the night decided the morning
hooks: The sore shoulder was decided at midnight.
You didn't sleep wrong. You slept at the wrong height.
Seven hours is a long time to hold your neck at an angle.

slots.hook: The sore shoulder was decided at midnight.
slots.headline: Not by how you slept. By how high.
slots.subhead: Seven hours at the wrong height, then a morning spent working it out.

concepts.angle: A1 pain-led: the night decided the morning
hooks: The morning starts the night before.
Same bed. Same person. Different height.
One of these mornings takes twenty minutes to get going.

slots.before_copy: Wake up stiff. Roll the shoulder. Wait for it to loosen off.

concepts.angle: A4 mechanism: your shoulder sets the height
hooks: Soft or firm is the wrong question.
Your shoulder already decided this.
Everyone shops on feel. Feel isn't the variable.

slots.hook: Soft or firm is the wrong question.
slots.step_1_desc: On your side, your head sits as far off the mattress as your shoulder is wide.
slots.step_2_title: The pillow fills it or it doesn't
slots.step_2_desc: Too little and your head drops. Too much and your neck bends the other way.
slots.step_3_desc: A soft one at the right height beats a firm one at the wrong height.

concepts.angle: A4 mechanism: the height only counts if it holds
hooks: The height only counts if it stays.
Every pillow is the right height for a while.
You didn't buy a flat pillow. It became one.

slots.hook: The height only counts if it stays.
slots.step_1_desc: The height you chose is not the height you keep.
slots.step_2_desc: It returns to the same shape every time you move off it.
slots.step_3_desc: Nothing to top up, fold under, or replace once it settles.

concepts.angle: A5 objection-busting: don't buy to find out
hooks: Fair question.
You shouldn't have to buy it to find out.
Everyone says 'give it two weeks'. You've done that already.

slots.objection: “I won't know if it suits me until I've slept on it for weeks.”
slots.reframe: Pick by your shoulder, before you spend.
slots.subhead: Height is a measurement, not a feeling. You can check it against yourself first.

concepts.angle: A5 objection-busting: measure instead of guessing
hooks: Two ways to choose a pillow.
One of these you've already tried.
Guessing has a cost. You've paid it a few times.

slots.hook: Two ways to choose a pillow.
slots.left_copy: Read the reviews. Pick soft or firm. Sleep on it a month. Find out.
slots.right_copy: Check your own shoulder. Match the height. Know before it ships.

concepts.angle: A3 desired-outcome: a night you sleep through
hooks: Straight through, or four times over.
How many times did you rearrange it last night?
The pillow you fix all night isn't working.

slots.before_copy: Roll over. Rearrange it. Fold it under. Try the other side. Again.

concepts.angle: A3 desired-outcome, entered through their own words
hooks: This is the whole problem, in one sentence.
Somebody else wrote this before we did.
If you've thought this, the ad is for you.

slots.hook: The whole problem, in one sentence.
slots.quote: If it’s too low I squish my shoulder and if it’s too high my neck will hurt.
slots.reviewer_meta: Verbatim — we didn’t write it and we didn’t pay for it
